scope: Prevent automatic city image assignment from geographically ambiguous source captions
examples: York GB versus New York City
Hudson NY versus Hudson River Park NYC
Brighton NY versus Brighton and Hove GB
behavior: Require explicit supported licence, required creator credit, WGS-84 source camera coordinates and distance at most 10 km from the authoritative stored city point; retain existing name and image quality gates. Abstain without erasing metadata. Bind publication to the city updated_at snapshot.

deployments.readback: all deployed file contents exactly equal reviewed bundle
all deployed file contents exactly equal reviewed bundle

limits: No new provider calls, model calls, retrieval budgets, authentication changes or frontend deployment. Missing source coordinates cause abstention; they do not establish that a photograph is wrong. No case clearance claimed by this source release. GitHub Actions account startup failure remains separate from passing local checks.
